scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The hypoxia–HIF-1α–p21/p27–cell-cycle arrest mechanism is biologically coherent and well established in tumors. The main weakness is treating HIF1A RNA abundance as a direct measure of HIF-1α activity, which is chiefly regulated through oxygen-dependent protein stabilization.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: Distance from vascular supply, hypoxia, HIF-1α activity, CDKN1A/CDKN1B induction, cell-cycle arrest, and reduced Ki-67 are integrated into a clear multistep mechanism. The use of a vascular/stromal boundary as a vascular proxy and HIF1A transcript abundance as an activity readout remains insufficiently resolved. No synthesis ceiling was applied because all principal contextual features contribute explicitly to the mechanism.
